answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the marble of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the violet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the oasis of the next round. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, split across independent auditors, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
